ROI_convention: Native160 pixels within retained256 photo /512 mainGFX /768 extra-mesh contexts. No resampling. Exact source coordinates, target hashes, original supervision indices and source credits accompany each image.
display: Common per-observation WB/matrix and sRGB; ordinary/faint+0EV, shadows+3/+5EV, mainGFX+2EV, extra mesh+4EV. Faint40x boards explicitly apply original camera DC+40*(value-DC), display only.
references: Processed Commons targets are exact synthetic GT; binned native-camera and independent DSCF3880/DSCF3835 ISO100 references are not GT. Both real scene pairs/JPEGs/siblings remain held out.
source_modifications: Binning, camera/color transform, cropping, sensor simulation and restoration. Enhanced faint boards additionally use declared shared40x display contrast.
